This page contains all you need to follow our hands-on workshop on predicting deprivation from space, delivered at [SPACERAISE'26](https://2026.gisruk.org/). This is the _Geo data lab (theme: Cities)_. The workshop explores how satellite data can be inserted into the decoding of socio-economic measures such as the UK's Index of Deprivation. The session is delivered through live coding in Python.

## Workshop Details

**Date:** Monday 18th May 2026  
**Time:** 16:00 – 17:30  
**Content:** See [Materials](/Materials.qmd) 

## Requirements

To get the most out of the workshop, participants should:

- Bring a laptop  
- Be comfortable with basic Python 

However, we think there's enough interesting stuff that does _not_ rely on
Python, so don't make that deal breaker!

## 🛠️ Contributing

Please read our [Contributing Guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md) for step-by-step instructions on how to:
